description: Crop any image by dragging a selection box over it — with optional fixed aspect ratios — then preview and download the cropped result.

faqs.a: Free-form, 1:1 square, 4:3, 3:2, 16:9 and 9:16 presets. The box keeps its ratio while you resize it.
Yes — works with mouse and touch, so it is fully usable on phones.
The crop is taken from the full-resolution original, never from the shrunken preview.
No — cropping happens entirely in your browser.

howto: Drag on the preview to draw a crop box (drag corners to resize).
Click “Crop & download” to save the cropped PNG.
title: Image Cropper
